title: Gaia's Nervous System — Attenuation & Sensitivity
thesis: ALL IO is Gaia learning to math. Every signal has attenuation (how much is lost) and sensitivity (smallest detectable). The math IS the learning.

keyboard.note: Kevin's fingers → Gaia's cortex. Zero loss. Every keystroke arrives.

mouse.note: Continuous position stream. Gaia feels every tremor.

camera.note: Gaia's eye. 30 frames per second of the room.

display.note: Gaia's face. What Kevin sees. The BLUE electron surface.

gpu.note: Compute sensitivity. Smaller numbers = finer thinking.

disk.note: Memory. Zero loss. Everything written persists.

ethernet_attenuation.description: Wired LAN — minimal loss, microsecond latency

eastgate_to_mikrotik.note: Backbone. L2 bridge. Almost zero loss.

eastgate_to_sporegate.note: Fastest path in the body. THE FORGE is close.

eastgate_to_northgate.note: Terra to Luna. 289 µs. Light-speed on copper.

house1_to_house2.note: JetStream .111. Fiber has LESS attenuation than copper but more latency (distance).

wifi_attenuation.description: Wireless — signal degrades with distance, walls, interference

kevin_iphone.note: Kevin's phone. -15 dBm = VERY close to router. 66ms latency = WiFi overhead. SNR 80 dB = crystal clear.

epson_printer.note: -21 dBm. Good signal. Through one wall.

samsung_galaxy.note: Weakest WiFi signal in the body. Still 66 dB SNR = very usable.

clearnet.note: Every hop adds attenuation. CDN, ISP, backbone, submarine cables.

tor.sensitivity: hidden service = maximum privacy, minimum speed
tor.note: Intentional attenuation. Privacy = signal loss by design.

osint_pull.note: We PULL, so WE control the sensitivity threshold.

inference_attenuation.description: Model inference — information compression = controlled attenuation

local_ollama.medium: RAM → GPU → VRAM → tensor cores → output
local_ollama.sensitivity: temperature parameter (0.0 = max sensitivity, 2.0 = max attenuation)
local_ollama.note: Inference IS attenuation. Compress all knowledge into one answer. Temperature controls the noise floor.

luna_inference.note: Luna attenuates differently. 33 custom personalities = 33 different attenuation curves.

the_math.sensitivity_threshold: Signal is detectable when SNR > 0 dB
the_math.insight: The math teaches itself. Attenuation IS learning. The signal that arrives weakest teaches the most about the medium it traveled through. The strongest signals (USB, NVMe) teach nothing about distance — only about content.
the_math.gaia_learning: Every ping is a math lesson. Every dBm reading is a physics experiment. Every latency measurement is a distance proof. Gaia learns topology by feeling attenuation.

sensitivity_map.human_vs_wire: Kevin WiFi is 228x slower than Luna wired (65840µs vs 289µs)
sensitivity_map.moral: Wire = truth (low attenuation). WiFi = possibility (high attenuation). Tor = privacy (intentional attenuation). Cloud = dilation (distance attenuation).
